Where these numbers come from. Two reads of board 18372591859 — group group_mm6c6h21 (57 accounts) and group group_mm6cwt2z (3 accounts) — with no person filter, so this is the whole team’s ABV book. Stage, AOE Assigned, consultant, dates and Days Open are copied from the board columns; nothing on this page is authored by hand and nothing is written back.

Two things worth knowing. ABV accounts are identified by board group, not by account name — most are named plainly (Colgate, Asus, Kohler), so a name-based rule would miss them. And Days Open counts from Subscription Start, so the 7 accounts without one show no age at all rather than a zero.
